answer: Locks are entered in plume, expire in signal, and ember lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 116 aliases as a result needs 150 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1792 identities would post 4845 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
